issues.where: the herd on the shore, all twelve frames
issues.what: over 6 s the animals hold the same poses and spacing; the whole group only creeps a few pixels left together, like sprites sliding, with no steps, weight shifts, head turns or one animal breaking from the rest
issues.fix: give each animal its own gait and timing, let some graze, stop, turn or lift a head, and move feet with real steps, not a group slide

issues.where: the lake surface and its reflection
issues.what: the orange ripple pattern and the reflection of the cliff stay almost frozen frame to frame, changing at an even trickle; the water reads as a still texture, not a wind-moved surface
issues.fix: drive the ripples with travelling wind gusts so the cat's-paws cross the water, break up the reflection and change brightness over time

issues.where: the band of mist along the far shore
issues.what: the only clearly moving element, and it changes at the same rate every step (an even drift), reading as a sliding overlay rather than vapour that pours and pools
issues.fix: let the mist thicken, thin and curl unevenly, settle into the low ground and lift off the water in places

issues.where: the sky and the thin cloud streak
issues.what: the sky and cloud are pixel-identical for 6 s; nothing drifts at its own height
issues.fix: give the high cloud a slow drift and let the light on the cliff shift slightly with it

issues.where: the cliff face and the foreground rocks
issues.what: fully static, which is correct for rock, but no light change or shadow from the cloud or mist plays across them, so the place reads as a held picture
issues.fix: pass soft shadow or light variation from the cloud and mist over the cliff and shore
